title: Getting started
description: Answer a few questions to register. It takes about 3 minutes.
resubmitDescription: Please update your application and send it again.

fields.lastNameKana: Last name in katakana (フリガナ)
fields.firstNameKana: First name in katakana (フリガナ)

hints.nameRomaji: In Latin letters, e.g. Yamada / Taro.
hints.nameKanji: If you have a name in kanji, we recommend entering it with its katakana reading (フリガナ) so Japanese classmates and teachers can find you by name. After approval, changes need a request. Leave it empty if you don't have one (e.g. international students).
hints.nameAtAis: If different from your current name (e.g. maiden name or nickname).
hints.dateOfBirth: Used only for verification and age-appropriate privacy. Never shown to other members.
hints.locale: Used for emails and LINE messages.
hints.schoolEmail: Required if you currently work at AIS: confirm your @aisnagoya.net address with a code (it's not used for sign-in or notices). Optional for former staff.
hints.parentConfirmation: Student accounts must also be confirmed by a parent or guardian with an AIS Alumni account, or by the committee.
hints.classmates: If you add them, we can ask classmates or teachers to confirm you, which can speed up approval.
hints.cohort: Classes are numbered by the year they finish 6th grade (2016 = 第5期). If you joined or left partway, choose the class you were in.
hints.types: You can ask the committee to change this later.
hints.leftYearStudent: Only if you left AIS before graduating. Leave empty if you're still at AIS or graduated.
hints.leftYearTeacher: Leave empty if you still work at AIS.
hints.gender: Used for your default profile icon; not shown to other members. After sending, changes need a request.

review.title: Check your answers
review.note: After you send it, a committee member will review it. We'll let you know by email.

stepTitles.details: Tell us about your time at AIS

stepIntros.type: Choose everything that applies — for example an alumnus whose child now attends AIS can pick both.
stepIntros.basics: The committee uses this to confirm who you are. Your birthday is never shown to other members.
stepIntros.details: Just give your class (学年) and years — whether you're a current student or an alumnus, and your grade, are worked out automatically.
stepIntros.review: If everything looks right, send it. The committee will review it and let you know.

sections.teacher: Tell us when you worked at AIS and what you taught.

child.reviewNote: The committee reviews your children’s details, not yours. Your account opens once a child is approved (or, for a registered child, once they confirm you).
child.modeLegend: How would you like to add this child?

existing.title: Already registered
existing.description: For example, a graduate with their own account, or a child another parent already registered.

new.title: Register my child
new.description: We’ll create your child’s record; you manage it. Our committee checks these details.

child.searchIntro: Your child appears only if their full name (romaji or kanji) and date of birth exactly match their registration.
child.searchNameHint: In romaji or kanji, as registered. e.g. Hanako Yamada or 山田花子
child.found: {count, plural, one {# match found} other {# matches found}}. Select your child.
child.notFound: No registered member matches this name and date of birth. Check the spelling, or register your child as new.
child.searchIncomplete: Enter your child’s full name and date of birth.
child.searchFailed: The search didn’t work. Please try again.
child.confirmNote: We’ll ask your child (or the parent who manages their account) to confirm that you’re their parent.
child.newIntro: We’ll create your child’s record; you manage it. Our committee checks these details.
child.leftYearHint: Only if your child left AIS before graduating. Leave empty if they’re still at AIS or graduated.

diploma.title: Diploma (卒業証書)
diploma.intro: If you graduated from AIS, upload a photo or scan of your diploma. The committee uses it to confirm you attended, and deletes it 30 days after deciding.
diploma.label: Diploma file
diploma.hint: JPG, PNG or PDF (up to 10 MB). Make sure your name and graduation year are readable.
diploma.unavailableHint: If so, add any other document that shows you attended (report card, a yearbook photo, …) below.

parentRegistered.title: It looks like a parent has already registered you.
parentRegistered.body: Ask them to send you a link with “Hand over to my child” on their Family page: you'll get the approved record with no new review. You can also continue here; the committee will then combine the two accounts.

classYears.title: Class {number}: classes by year (to check)
classYears.hint: The class for each school year (April–March). Check it matches the classes you remember.

kanjiReminder.title: No kanji / kana name yet
kanjiReminder.body: You can send without it, but we recommend adding it so Japanese classmates and teachers can find you by name (adding it after approval needs a request). If you don't have a kanji name, just send.
